# Environment variables

| Name | Kind | Value rule | Processes | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MIGENT_DEBUG` | flag | on for `1`, `true` | cli, service, process-wrapper | Writes the process-wrapper start/stop trace to stderr and debug.log. The wrapper reads its inherited value once at startup. |
| `MIGENT_NO_INPUT` | flag | on for `1` | cli | Same effect as --no-input: never prompt. |
| `MIGENT_HOME` | path | default `<os home>/.migent` | cli, service | Overrides the directory that holds Migent's user-level state, including the registry. |
| `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` | child_default | default `1` for `npx skills` | cli | Migent does not interpret it. When `migent skill` spawns `npx skills`, the caller's value passes through; if absent, it is set to the default. |
